title: Delete zero-caller backend code and 13 orphan frontend scripts
goal: Remove code that nothing references and that is not part of the downstream contract. pkg/common/token.go is a 129-line whole-file pass-through to pkg/authtoken and pkg/common/http with 34 exports and zero callers; pkg/common/http/cookie.go:89 SetTokenTTL exists only to serve it. logging_middleware.go defines a Gin middleware that no router registers. common.ErrorResponse is never constructed. database.SetEx has no caller. frontend/src/api/request.ts:241 isForbiddenRequestError has no consumer. Thirteen frontend scripts (ten capture-*.mjs plus merge-coverage-to-lcov.mjs, migrate-spacing-tokens.mjs and run-request-error-utils-test.mjs) appear in no package.json script, no CI workflow and no other script. Deleting them changes no runtime behaviour and removes a second, contradictory way to do things that already has a supported way.
findings: RC-001 (P1): backend/pkg/common/token.go:1-129 is a pure pass-through: constants, type aliases and about 20 wrappers over pkg/authtoken and pkg/common/http, including the deprecated GenerateOperationToken and ParseOperationToken. Whole-repo and pantheon-ops overlay search returns hits only inside token.go. Its only effect on another file is that pkg/common/http/cookie.go:89 SetTokenTTL has exactly one caller, this file.
RC-002 (P1): backend/internal/middleware/logging_middleware.go:12-39 defines StructuredLoggingMiddleware; no router or server file registers it, and the actual request logging is done elsewhere.
RC-003 (P2): backend/pkg/common/error.go:106-115 defines the exported ErrorResponse struct; nothing constructs or references it, and pkg/common/http/response.go holds the live private equivalent.
RC-005 (P3): backend/pkg/database/redis.go:76 SetEx wraps rdb.Set and has zero callers.
RC-009 (P3): frontend/src/api/request.ts:241 exports isForbiddenRequestError; no module, barrel or overlay consumer imports it.
RC-010 (P2): ten frontend/scripts/capture-*.mjs files are one-off screenshot helpers referenced by no package.json script, no .github/workflows entry and no sibling script.

RC-011 (P2): frontend/scripts/merge-coverage-to-lcov.mjs, migrate-spacing-tokens.mjs and run-request-error-utils-test.mjs have the same zero-reference status; migrate-spacing-tokens.mjs is a completed one-off migration.

in: Delete SetTokenTTL from backend/pkg/common/http/cookie.go:89 and keep the internal AccessTokenTTL / RefreshTokenTTL defaults that cookie.go itself uses
Delete the ErrorResponse type from backend/pkg/common/error.go:106-115
Prove the deletions with five-location reference searches recorded in evidence: backend source, backend tests, frontend, scripts/CI config, pantheon-ops business overlay
out: Any change to pkg/authtoken or pkg/common/http behaviour, including token TTL defaults
Removing or rewriting the live logging middleware
Changing any route, response shape, error code or i18n key
Replacing deleted helpers with new abstractions

implementationNotes: Do the five-location search again at implementation time rather than trusting this packet: the audit ran it on 2026-10-27 and the tree may have moved.
If any _test.go file references a deleted symbol, that symbol is not dead. Restore it and close the item as a false positive instead of editing the test.
pkg/common/http/cookie.go uses its own private TTL variables; deleting the exported SetTokenTTL must not delete them.

capture-*.mjs deletion is gated on the maintainer confirming they are no longer used for manual visual walkthroughs; the rest of the wave does not depend on that answer and can land separately if needed.
No replacement helper is introduced. The supported path already exists in pkg/authtoken and pkg/common/http.

executionRoles.implementerPosture: Pure deletion, one commit per backend package and one for the scripts; stop and restore if the compiler or a test disagrees.
reviewerPosture: Confirm each deletion carries a fresh five-location search result in the evidence.
Confirm no test file was edited.
